climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, warm summer

climate: Chardonnay, Syrah and Merlot sit in their sweet spot, so the wines can show the style they are known for.

blurb.text: A geographical indication on New Zealand's North Island where Chardonnay leads at 26% of the vines.
